g.text: A mark is one derivation. A blue mark is a declared value an adapter reads with no assignment between,
a grey one a pinned fact read the same way, and an amber one a layer-2 assignment.
In-degree at least one is the in row: nothing is rendered that no declaration or assignment produced.
A row appears where it reaches an object of this concern. An assignment of this concern that reaches
no object stays as a row reading zero, so an assignment nothing serialises is visible.
